gap_records.claim: Player facing follows the last horizontal input and is observable as a node/animation state

execution_records.observation: input replay records only position quadruples plus input_axis=None; it never reports Player.facing, so facing is not observable from the deterministic battery
a read-only face check: move_right reported facing=1 (passed); a move_left injection also reported facing=1 (expected -1, failed) in the round game process

gap_records.player_impact: The character never turns when walking left, so direction is not a readable player-facing state
gap_records.recommended_update: Make facing follow the sign of the horizontal axis and add a deterministic facing assertion to the battery replay

gap_records.claim: Hitting a wall blocks horizontal movement with no tunnelling
gap_records.player_impact: The player may pass through walls or get stuck; the corridor does not delimit the play area
gap_records.recommended_update: Replay move_right into the Wall node and assert Player.position.x stays below the wall's left face

gap_records.claim: At least one enemy patrols a platform and turns at its edges or on walls
gap_records.player_impact: Enemies stand still, so there is no patrol obstacle to time jumps against
gap_records.recommended_update: Sample Enemy1.position over 120 frames and assert its x changes and then reverses

gap_records.claim: Side or bottom contact with an enemy costs a life or starts the death flow

gap_records.recommended_update: Drive the player into Enemy1 from the side and assert HUD/Lives decreases or the death flow fires

gap_records.claim: Landing on an enemy from above destroys it and bounces the player up
gap_records.player_impact: The player cannot defeat enemies, losing the main platformer affordance
gap_records.recommended_update: Replay a jump onto Enemy1 and assert the enemy is freed/queued_free and Player.velocity.y becomes negative
